item.title: Combiner 0.6.0
item.description:
• Impact watch, and log lines with a level and an area
  • Take folders share each take, and the dry print is the comp
  • Disk reserve setting and warnings, one copy per identity, old-render cap, Advanced and Unusual setups
  • Report a problem, and crash reports offered after a crash
  • Ableton Live background renders (second Live, groups as stems)
